metadata.title: Privacy Policy | VSCS
metadata.description: Privacy policy of VS Construction Services Ltd. – information on the collection, use and protection of personal data.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: This Personal Data Protection Policy aims to inform visitors to the website of VS CONSTRUCTION SERVICES, Ltd., UIC 206671079, with registered office and management address at: 4 Petropavlovska St., Vratsa, represented by Stefan Dimitrov Ormanliev, hereinafter referred to as the "Controller", about how personal data is collected, used, stored and protected.
This Policy is compliant with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the Personal Data Protection Act and applicable European and Bulgarian legislation.

sections.title: 2. Categories of Data Subjects
paragraphs: The Controller processes personal data of the following categories of individuals:

items: Individuals who have submitted an inquiry or message through the website

sections.title: 3. Types of Personal Data
paragraphs: Depending on the purpose, the following may be processed:

items: Education and professional experience data, CV, cover letter and other documents
Directly from individuals through forms and file uploads
Automatically through use of the website
Via email and other communication channels

sections.title: 6. Legal Bases
paragraphs: Processing is carried out on the basis of:

sections.title: 7. Mandatory or Voluntary Nature
paragraphs: Providing certain data is necessary for:
paragraphsAfter: Failure to provide such data may result in inability to participate in recruitment or receive a response to an inquiry.

items: Until the recruitment procedure is completed, or
For up to 6 months thereafter, unless explicit consent is given for a longer period
For the period prescribed by law
Public authorities where required by law

sections.title: 10. Transfer of Data Outside the EU
paragraphs: Personal data is not transferred outside the EU, except where appropriate safeguards are in place.

sections.title: 11. Automated Decision-Making
paragraphs: The Controller does not apply automated decision-making or profiling.

sections.title: 13. Security Breaches
paragraphs: In the event of a personal data incident, the Controller will notify the competent authorities and affected individuals within the statutory time limits.

sections.title: 14. Cookies
paragraphsAfter: Users can manage cookies through their browser settings.

sections.title: 15. External Links
paragraphs: The website may contain links to external sites for which the Controller is not responsible.

items: To lodge a complaint with the CPDP (Commission for Personal Data Protection)

sections.title: 18. Changes to the Policy
paragraphs: The Controller reserves the right to amend this policy. All changes will be published on the website.

content.effectiveDate: Date of entry into force of the latest changes: 15 January 2026
